steps.en: Add the package to your React 18+ app
steps.zh: 把这个包加进你的 React 18+ 应用

steps.en: Set a few seed tokens once on the root ConfigProvider
steps.zh: 在根部的 ConfigProvider 上设一次几个种子令牌

steps.en: Derives the full palette, states and dark or compact variants from those seeds
steps.zh: 从种子令牌推导出整套色板、状态色和暗色/紧凑变体

steps.en: Import the components each screen needs and pass them data and callbacks
steps.zh: 按页面引入需要的组件，传入数据和回调

steps.en: Generates each component's CSS from the tokens at runtime and injects it
steps.zh: 运行时按令牌生成各组件的 CSS 并注入页面

steps.en: Handles sorting, filtering, validation, popups and keyboard states inside each component
steps.zh: 在组件内部处理排序、筛选、校验、弹层和键盘状态

value.en: A consistent, themed back-office UI built from finished components, with no component CSS or widget logic written by you
value.zh: 用成品组件拼出风格统一、可换主题的中后台，组件 CSS 和控件逻辑一行不用写

sources: https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design README.md — Install (npm install antd); Usage (import { Button, DatePicker } from 'antd';); Features (theme customization based on CSS-in-JS)

https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design docs/react/customize-theme.en-US.md — Seed Token example (token: { colorPrimary: '#1890ff' }), Seed → Map → Alias derivation, preset algorithms, zeroRuntime (6.0.0)
https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design docs/react/migration-v6.en-US.md — React >= 18, CSS variables by default
